Metadata.Goal: Add cross-file vfs-import resolution to xnl-core: parse `<Imports><Import as src="vfs://">`, build per-alias symbol tables (same-alias merge, duplicate error), reuse loader exports/batchLoad, with dependency-inverted resolver and zero-import fallback.
Metadata.Description: Implement the xnl-import capability so XNL documents can import file/directory targets by vfs path under an alias namespace, enabling fractal multi-file registries (downstream: codument add-modeling-registry).

TaskSpace.name: add-vfs-import-resolver
TaskSpace.Description: Phases: spec/API, core resolver implementation, vfs resolver adapter (optional), tests.

TaskGroup.name: Spec and API
TaskGroup.Description: Author behavior delta and finalize the resolveImports API + Import directive grammar.

Task.name: Author xnl-import behavior delta
Task.Description: behavior_deltas/xnl-import: import-directive, alias-namespace, resolver-dependency-inversion, zero-import-fallback. (Applied to behaviors registry at archive.)

Task.name: Finalize ImportResolver + resolveImports API
Task.Description: ImportResolver (readFile/readDir/isDir); resolveImports signature; vfs addressing @/ ./ ..; scheme/error taxonomy (INVALID_IMPORT/IMPORT_NOT_FOUND/DUPLICATE_IMPORT/UNRESOLVED_IMPORT).

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: API and error taxonomy defined; core does not hard-depend on xnl-vfs

TaskGroup.name: Core resolver implementation
TaskGroup.Description: Implement Import parsing + resolveImports in xnl-core, reusing loader exports/batchLoad. packages/core/src/import/index.ts.

Task.name: Parse Imports + resolve file/dir sources
Task.Description: Parse <Imports>/<Import as src>; resolveVfsSrc for @/ ./ ..; load file or directory (.xnl, sorted) via injected resolver.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: File and directory-package imports load via injected resolver with correct vfs addressing

Task.name: Per-alias symbol table + reference validation
Task.Description: Build per-alias namespaces from batchLoad exports; same-alias merge with provenance; duplicate-id error; validate alias:name references; unresolved error; zero-import fallback.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: alias:name resolves; same-alias merges; duplicate/unresolved/not-found raise errors

Task.name: Export resolveImports from xnl-core
Task.Description: Added resolveImports/resolveVfsSrc/XnlImportError + types to packages/core/src/index.ts and the XNL namespace.

TaskGroup.name: vfs resolver adapter (optional)
TaskGroup.Description: Optional VirtualFileSystem-backed ImportResolver so callers can resolve vfs:// against an xnl-vfs tree or local fs. Deferred: codument can supply its own resolver over LocalFsVfsPersistence.

Task.name: VfsImportResolver adapter
Task.Description: Bridge VirtualFileSystem (or LocalFsVfsPersistence) to ImportResolver (readFile/readDir/isDir over vfs:// paths).

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Adapter resolves imports against a real vfs tree

TaskGroup.name: Tests
TaskGroup.Description: Tests for directive parsing, vfs addressing, dir-package import, alias merge, duplicate/unresolved/not-found errors, dependency-inverted (mock) resolver, zero-import fallback.

Task.name: Add import resolver tests
Task.Description: tests/import.test.ts with a mock ImportResolver covering all behaviors (8 cases).

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: 8 import tests pass; full suite 54 pass; tsc --noEmit clean
